listing.name: SCY Utility Ship Pack
listing.summary: This is a sub ship pack mod for the Scy Nation's: created by Tartiflette, Music by Fastland, With the help of Debido, Mesotronik, Dark Revenant, Histidine, Silentstormpt, SniZupGun, Deathfly, 19_30 and many others; updated for the 0.97a-RC11 by starficz.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a collection of utility ships, including tankers, transports, and specialized vessels, to the Scy Nation faction.

description:
Hello !

This is a sub ship pack mod for the Scy Nation's: created by Tartiflette, Music by Fastland, With the help of Debido, Mesotronik, Dark Revenant, Histidine, Silentstormpt, SniZupGun, Deathfly, 19_30 and many others; updated for the 0.97a-RC11 by starficz.

If you use a old version: always DELETE it before extracting the new one and you must start a new game.

For the moment it's aearly state, not well balance:

Download

Requires:
Scy Nation's
LazyLib
MagicLib

Ships

Compatible with Nexerelin

Futur plan:
-Experimental destroyer,
-Mining fregat,
-...

Changelogs
V 0.61a
BUGFIX
Fix a problem with SCY_engineJumpstart that crash the game.

V 0.6a
17/10/2024
NEW CONTENT
- Zemyna:      Colonization vessel, based on intothewildblueyonder work
- Kelpie:      Yacht
- Ifrit:      Combat Tanker
- Dionysos:   Combat Tanker
- Sybaris:      Anti-fighter destroyer
- Protector:   Laser Point defense
- Medium Swarmer

IMPROVEMENTS
- Various graphics improvements of the Helios, Ares, Notus.

V 4.0a
25/04/2024
NEW CONTENT
- Amaru:   Exploration Corvete
- Oni:   Drone tender
- Balius:   Civilian Transport

V 3.0a
15/03/2023
NEW CONTENT
- Wyrm:   Combat Tanker
- Ananta:   Combat Heavy Tug
- Makara:   Freighter

V 0.2a
11/04/2023
NEW CONTENT
- Pixie:   Salvage shuttle.
- Haetae:   Science vessel.
- A new variant of the Deimos : standard.

BALANCING
- Ares: increase DP, cost, modify stats, delete one satyr wing, changing weapons to make it a better combat carrier.
- Deimos: changing weapons and stats to improve his fighting ability.

BUGFIXES/IMPROVEMENTS
- Satyr: fix bug with shield and weapons that didn't work.
- Various graphics improvements of the Helios, Ares, Deimos, Satyr, Notus.

V 0.11a
30/01/2023
Fix a problem with a hullmod that crash the game.

V 0.1a
28/01/2023
INITIAL RELEASE
- Helios:   Combat troop transport.
- Deimos:   Combat freighter.
- Ares   :   EMP heavy drone carrier.
=>   Satyr:   EMP drone corvette.
=>   Egipan:   EMP   drone.
- Thesus:   Heavy tanker.
- Ariadne:   Mining barge.
=>   Notus:   Mining corvette.

Off course like the original mod, Scy Utility can freely be re-used by anyone and the sprites can freely be kitbashed from without asking with 3 conditions: It must be for a Starsector mod, that mod must have a similarly permissive license, and I am credited.

aiDescription: Expands the Scy Nation fleet with various utility ships such as combat tankers, colonization vessels, and mining barges. Includes specific roles like drone tenders, exploration corvettes, and civilian transports. The pack is currently in an early state and requires a new game to install.
